summary: Add production 32 MiB Japanese and Simplified Chinese support: verified 3,414/3,414 zero-fallback full-game catalogs generated from pinned authored shards, licensed deterministic CJK font assets and a multilingual Huffman codec, UTF-8 language UI with persisted first-start/Config switching, localization host/build/runtime gates, and captured CJK playtest scenarios (see docs/localization.md, docs/game_locale_sources.md, and docs/cjk_fonts.md).
